answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 152189 Country: india Title: I am a male can I watch video bayanat of male orator? Question: I am a male can I watch video bayanat of male orator? Answer ID: 152189 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1119/1027/H=9/1438) It is not free from sin for a male to see the picture of a male unnecessarily. If there is nothing objectionable in the speech and the speaker is reliable and authentic then there is no harm in listening the audio speech and gain benefit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
